teaching_notes.case_specific_focus: A valid room-transition boundary can coexist with an unnecessary final boundary. This example rejects separating bedroom-door WAIT from the hallway approach that establishes the same terminal target.
teaching_notes.transfer_rule: For oversegmentation, identify the exact unnecessary cut. A new room crossing is not automatically wrong; a terminal placement attached to the same just-reached destination normally belongs with its approach.
teaching_notes.anti_pattern: Do not reject every region transition as oversegmented or force an entire multi-region route into one stage. Require a genuine independent objective at each proposed boundary.
